given: A Workroom build is running and Proxy is mid-sentence reporting progress.
when: A human speech onset barges in and someone says 'Proxy, quiet', then 'stop' targeting the build.
then: Silero VAD stops TTS within 200ms and flushes the buffer; 'quiet' silences voice while tile+chat stay live; the abort registry aborts the in-flight build model loop finally (abort-is-final) so no resume or JSON-retry ever resurrects it.
